data.name: Sachidananda
data.gender_notes: Sachidananda is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Sachidananda' means 'One who is pure and full of bliss'. The name Sachidananda carries the meaning “Pure Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sachidananda usually hope their child will grow to embody pure bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is considered sacred in Hinduism and is often given to babies born in spiritual families or to those who are believed to have a deep spiritual connection.
data.etymology: Sachidananda belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure Bliss.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sachidananda total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sachidananda holds great significance in Hindu culture, especially in the context of ancient Indian spiritual traditions. The compound of 'Sachidana' in the name, where 'Sat' represents truth and 'Chit' refers to consciousness, denotes a being who embodies the eternal truth and cosmic consciousness. This name was often revered for spiritual leaders, seers, and scholars who were known to be deeply connected to their spiritual practices and were considered masters of their knowledge domains.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sachidananda signifies an individual who is determined to attain truth and experience constant bliss in their consciousness, unattached and undisturbed by the transient realities and imperfections of the material world. This name echoes the sentiments of the spiritual seeker that yearns for the ultimate reality of existence - an experience of pure, uncontaminated consciousness and divine love (anandam). Thus, the name Sachidananda is more than just a moniker; it symbolizes a state of being where one's existence is infused with undying truth and eternal bliss.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sachidananda: Truth-Bliss. A name that embodies the ultimate reality of consciousness, where truth and bliss merge in the self-realization of the soul.

historical_references.reference: Sachidananda was a prominent 12th century Hindu philosopher and Jaina scholar. He wrote extensively on various Jaina topics and is known for his commentaries on the Agama texts.

Sachidananda was also the founder of the Natha sect of Hinduism, which emphasized the spiritual importance of the body and the attainment of spiritual liberation through the control of the senses. He is often referred to as the 'Natharaj' or 'Lord of the Nathas'.
historical_references.context: Hindu spirituality and the founding of the Natha sect
